sourceNote: Printed page 59: a full-page map titled “غزوۃ احد” redrawn schematically (Mount Uhud, palm groves, lava field, the dotted routes, a compass and a scale in miles); the small handwritten-style map labels are only partly legible, so only the legend text is given as read: “ہجرت کے وقت حضرت محمد رسول اللہ خاتم النبیین کا راستہ” and “جنگِ احد سے پہلے اور بعد میں قریش کا راستہ”. English and Pashto are our translations (need native review); watermark, handwriting, page-edge shadows, a thumb at the page edge and ornamental borders excluded. Scan n = printed page n+1 (file = {p//2:03d}_page_2 for even printed page p, {(p-1)//2:03d}_page_1 for odd p).
